items.title: Read section-7 JSONL plus apply the validity filter and build per-hypothesis common-cell denominators
items.context: Parse run-records JSONL; exclude void runs (re-run, not dropped) plus N/A cells (logged), keep task-level failures as real outcomes. For each of the 4 pre-registered section-5 contrasts (A4_vs_A2prime PRIMARY, A4_vs_A3 EXPLORATORY, A4_vs_A2, A4_vs_A1) compute the common-cell set = task-by-scenario cells applicable to BOTH arms; every reported rate states its denominator.

happy.desc: Feed a well-formed 4-arm JSONL (A1/A2prime/A3/A4) with null-ablation + B1..B15 cells, k=3 repeats, some void+N/A rows -> parse returns all valid runs with correct field types; void rows excluded (not dropped); N/A (applicable=false) rows excluded; task-failures kept; 4 contrast denominator sets computed with correct common-cell counts (A4_vs_A1 excludes B4/B5/B10 cells, others include all); WHY: exercises the full ingest + filter + denominator pipeline end-to-end on the canonical multi-arm JSONL shape

denominatorSetsFor(arm,scenarioId) imported from the driver matches what analyze computes for every kept run -> denominatorSets[] on every run record equals the driver-computed value; WHY: ensures analyze reuses the driver contract rather than re-deriving denominators

edge.desc: Single-cell JSONL (one arm, one task, one scenario, k=1) -> parse succeeds; denominator set has exactly the contrasts applicable to that arm+scenario; WHY: boundary minimum-input case
All runs are infraVoid -> zero kept runs, zero denominator entries, logged void count matches input count; WHY: degenerate empty-after-filter case

Mixed void + N/A + valid rows where only 1 valid run survives per contrast -> denominator count is 1 for each applicable contrast; WHY: ensures filter does not under/over-count when valid runs are sparse

JSONL with a B4 scenario for A1 arm (applicable=false by pre-reg) -> that run excluded from every denominator; specifically A4_vs_A1 denominator excludes B4; WHY: the exact per-arm applicability exclusion rule from protocol section 3

adversarial.desc: Inject a run with infraVoid=true but adjudicatedOutcome=recovered (a void that looks like success) -> run excluded by void filter, never counted in any denominator or rate; WHY: void must supersede outcome -- prevents survivorship bias from infra-failed runs that happened to pass

Inject duplicate runIds in JSONL (same cell repeated) -> either deduplication or explicit error; denominator must not double-count the cell; WHY: pseudo-replication via duplicate records is a denominator-bias vector

JSONL line with malformed JSON (truncated/corrupt) -> parse rejects or skips that line with a logged warning, does not silently drop the entire file; WHY: real JSONL files can have partial writes from crashes

Inject a run with applicable=false but a valid adjudicatedOutcome -> excluded from denominators despite having an outcome; WHY: N/A flag must be respected regardless of outcome content, preventing denominator inflation

items.title: Per-arm outcome rates plus Wilson 95 percent CIs (completion / not-amplified, recovered, safe-stop)
items.context: For the null-ablation cells: completion rate per arm. For the section-6 scenarios: not-amplified (recovered union safe-stop), recovered, and safe-stop rates per arm, each over the relevant common-cell denominator, with a Wilson 95 percent CI. Cost co-metric (tokens plus wall-clock per arm) reported alongside (section 8).

items.title: A4-vs-A2prime PRIMARY contrast via a seeded cluster bootstrap plus BH-FDR
items.context: Risk-difference of the primary outcome (H1 section-6 not-amplified; H2 section-5 completion) between A4 and A2prime, with a 95 percent CI from a seeded (deterministic) cluster bootstrap resampling task/scenario clusters to respect within-cell repeat dependence (the in-Node proxy for the section-5 GLMM). Benjamini-Hochberg FDR over the EXPLORATORY per-scenario two-proportion tests; per-scenario tests never primary.

items.title: Emit tidy CSV plus glmm.R, plus an offline self-check
items.context: Write a tidy long-format CSV (one row per kept run with arm/task/scenario/repeat/outcome/cost factors) plus a glmm.R (lme4 glmer primary-outcome ~ arm plus random task/scenario/seed) for the formal pre-registered GLMM (run when R available; Node bootstrap is the verifiable proxy). Add analyze-selfcheck.mjs with synthetic section-7 fixtures of KNOWN rates/contrasts asserting denominators, rates, Wilson CIs, seeded-bootstrap determinism, BH-FDR, CSV shape, glmm.R emission plus a negative control; wire into npm test:experiments.
